title: Evaluating AI Use
text:
A shared five-level scale (0-4) — from prohibited to a full creative partnership — gives everyone the same vocabulary for AI in graded work, declared per assignment rather than as a blanket policy.

AI detectors are not proof: they over-flag strong, fluent writing and are biased against non-native English writers, and their scores are probabilities from an imperfect model, not certainties. At best they point an investigation somewhere; they never close one.

As AI compresses the lower levels of Bloom's taxonomy, the more useful evaluations sit higher up: applying a framework to a specific case, weighing competing approaches, defending a real decision.
